name: rebel-bot-swarm
description: See your Claude Code sessions as a team: status, original avatars, who holds what, the messages between them, and a card edit panel. Local only.

commands.title: Rebel Bot Swarm: Open requests folder

rebelBotSwarm.boardFile.markdownDescription: Optional team board (Markdown) with `## Sessions`, `## Files being edited`, a `## ... slot` table and `## Waiting ...` list. See the guide in `docs/`. `~` = your home folder.

rebelBotSwarm.privateMembers.description: Members (name or part of a name) whose messages stay hidden. Their status still shows.

rebelBotSwarm.refreshSeconds.description: How often the open panel reads the session files.

enumDescriptions: Sessions started in the open workspace folders
All live Claude Code sessions on this computer

rebelBotSwarm.avatarsFolder.description: Optional folder of your own pictures (.png .jpg .svg) named after members. Empty = drawn avatars only.

rebelBotSwarm.requestsFolder.markdownDescription: Folder for the request files from **Add team member** and the edit panel (task and role instructions), for your coordinator session to read. Empty = VS Code's storage folder for this extension (command **Rebel Bot Swarm: Open requests folder**). `~` = your home folder.

rebelBotSwarm.membersFile.markdownDescription: File that keeps the names and avatars you choose in the edit panel (JSON; a backup is made before each change). Empty = `members.json` in VS Code's storage folder for this extension. `~` = your home folder.

rebelBotSwarm.agentCards.markdownDescription: Also show a **ready** card for each agent file in `~/.claude/agents/` that has no card yet (name from the file name, job from its `description:` line).
